summary: Tested 3 new features: Menu Explorer (header-apps-btn), page /mouvement, and onboarding preparation screen. All 3 features are functional. Found and fixed one CRITICAL crash bug in Onboarding.jsx: `useEffect` was used but not imported — would have crashed the preparation screen (ReferenceError) as soon as user clicked 'Lancer mon cockpit'. Fixed by adding useEffect to the import. All flows now pass end-to-end.

minor.issue: Rejects arbitrary emails like qa.prep.<random>@zayado.fr with 403 'Compte de démo non autorisé.' — the request's suggested QA flow (jetable emails) is blocked by an email whitelist. Only pre-provisioned demo accounts (thomas@zayado.fr etc.) work. Not a bug per se, but the review request's suggested procedure is not supported.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: useEffect used at line 50 but not imported (only useMemo, useState imported). Preparation screen would crash with 'useEffect is not defined' after clicking submit. FIXED by testing agent — added useEffect to import statement.

action_items: Review the useEffect import fix applied to /app/frontend/src/pages/Onboarding.jsx (line 1) — confirm the change is acceptable.
Optional: If QA needs to use jetable emails for onboarding, extend /api/auth/demo-login whitelist or provide a dedicated QA endpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: Onboarding.jsx: missing useEffect import was a blocking crash — ESLint react/no-undef would have caught this. Consider running lint pre-commit.
Layout.jsx (ECOSYSTEM_ITEMS + dropdown) is well structured with clear data-testid coverage. Toast for unavailable modules works as designed.
Mouvement.jsx is concise, optimistic UI update on check with rollback on API failure — good pattern.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after fix (0% before fix on onboarding preparation)

test_credentials: thomas@zayado.fr via POST /api/auth/demo-login (only whitelisted demo accounts accepted)
seed_data_creation: Created one task 'Test semaine mouvement' via /api/tasks, then marked it complete. It now appears in mouvement-bouge (completed section).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new features verified end-to-end: (1) Menu Explorer shows 7 ecosystem items with correct testids; ecosystem-mouvement navigates to /mouvement, ecosystem-pilotage shows toast 'Pilotage sera disponible dans le prochain lot.' without navigation. (2) /mouvement shows page-mouvement, mouvement-en-cours, mouvement-bouge; capture -> appears in en-cours; check -> success toast + moves to bouge; mouvement-copilote-btn opens right drawer. (3) Onboarding preparation screen shows title with firstname, progressive checklist items (3 items visible after ~2.8s, bar at 75%), redirects to / after ~4s. Non-regression: /, /vision, /refuge load OK. NOTE: demo-login endpoint whitelist blocks jetable emails — use thomas@zayado.fr.
rca of the issue: Onboarding.jsx crash: useEffect hook was referenced at line 50-59 to drive the animated preparation screen (progressive checklist + redirect via setTimeout), but only `useMemo, useState` were imported from 'react' on line 1. Reproduction: complete onboarding to step 3 and click 'Entrer dans mon cockpit' -> setPreparation(true) triggers re-render -> preparation screen mounts -> useEffect ReferenceError crashes React render. Mitigation applied: added useEffect to the react import.
